transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: ConversalQ security team, how can I help you?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I just got an email saying someone logged into my account from Russia. I didn't do that. I think I've been hacked.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand your concern and I'm treating this as a priority. For your security, I need to verify your identity before we proceed. Can you confirm the last 4 digits of the payment card on file?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I can confirm a login from an IP address in Moscow at 2:14 AM your time today. I'm immediately locking that session and any other active sessions except the one you're currently on.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Good. Should I change my password?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, please do that right now. I'll stay on the line. Go to account settings and change it to something strong — at least 12 characters with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great. I strongly recommend enabling two-factor authentication right now as well. Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. This will prevent access even if someone has your password.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Setting it up now... OK it's enabled.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I've flagged the unauthorized access in our security logs and sent a full report to your registered email. Please review your recent conversation history to check if anything was accessed inappropriately.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I will. Is there anything else I should do?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you used the same password on other services, change those too. Also consider running an antivirus scan on your devices. Your ConversalQ account is secured now.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Thank you, I really appreciate the quick response.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Of course. Your security is our priority. Stay safe!
